admission.justification: A future evidence-refresh change must not silently discard earlier own-owner provenance or replace a foreign owner history, making later readers unable to distinguish amendment from erasure.

applicability: Evidence updates to an invariant or record whose existing origin belongs to the same task and leaf owner as the authoring operation.
conditions: Without replace_evidence, preserve existing evidence and append distinct supplied evidence in stable order.
With replace_evidence, replace that owner-held evidence; an explicitly empty replacement removes the evidence field.
Preserve stored origin identity/handoff entry; another owner retains its origin and receives separate foreign-evidence handling rather than an overwrite.
exclusions: No replacement of a foreign owner origin.
Scope is owner identity and task, not a new promise of same-handoff-entry equality or altered invariant meaning.
statement: An own-origin entry replaces its stored evidence only when replace_evidence is true and otherwise appends it.
